citation: State of Bihar v. Ram Kumar (2022) 2 SCC 789
reasoning_summary: Conviction upheld. Dying declaration corroborated by demand letters recovered from scene. Pattern of dowry harassment established. Death occurred within 3 years of marriage triggering 304B presumption.

facts_established.actus_reus: Unnatural death within 7 years of marriage
facts_established.chain_of_custody: Handwritten demand letters match accused handwriting
